 The Trail Blazers hit the road to face off against the Sacramento Kings once more, and Schultzy has your instant reaction on the Locked On Blazers POSTCAST! Can the Blazers continue looking like one of the better teams in the Western Conference? Will we see another dominant performance from Damian Lillard or Deni Avdija tonight? Join the Locked On Blazers POSTCAST right after the final buzzer!
